_comment: Hand-crafted probe payload representing what Notifiarr (and similar *arr-aware tooling: Recyclarr, Homepage, Homarr, Janitorr) sends when first connecting to Romarr. The probe is a single GET /api/v3/system/status with X-Api-Key in the header, no request body. The response (Sonarr-shape JSON) is what these tools cache to recognise Romarr as an *arr peer.
